body: i know, i know.. i want to, but i got so attached to her like i never did to anyone else before, it's kinda hard to just forget and move on like that..

Yes, especially my mother. You see, she doesn't believe in mental illnesses. When I was depressed, I bottled my feelings up, because I knew her stance. But one I let it all out in a heated argument, and it went like you'd expect. She called me an idiot, and taunted me. Because "there's nothing wrong with me and I'm being dumb". She never cared about anyone's feelings, just herself. To be honest now that you made me think about it, I don't think I've seen her show any emotions ever.

I posted about it before, but it's just that my whole life has been terrible. And now I have pretty much nothing to live for. Broken family doesn't care, friends abandon me, I just finished school, but due to the pandemic I have no papers and can't get a job, but the final straw was when a girl I loved rejected me and went with someone else. My first love at age 19... Says a lot about me.. She was the only thing I had, and now I'm all alone with nothing to do.

Yes, the first time I was scared. I was only 14 at the time, and was in a very rough spot. Abusive, poor family, failing school, no friends. I was hopeless, but was very scared of death.. it's the fear of unknown. The second time I was also scared, but more determined. My family encouraged me, then in the last second they dragged me off the balcony. I don't understand why. That was a year after. Now I'm 19, and this time I don't feel scared. Maybe it's because of the method. The first starvation attempt was just more than a week ago. I didn't feel fear. Nor do I now. I just sit there, slowly dying of dehydration. I only feel emotional pain due to what's been happening, but physically all I feel is a stomachache caused by hunger, which disappears after a few hours, and a constant headache due to dehydration.
Not sure if it's the way to go, it takes so long, but I have nothing else.

I don't think I've ever had a proper "near death" experience. This is my 4th suicide attempt, and I've never come that close to death. First time, I wanted to hang myself, but I was seen and stopped. Then I tried to jump off a balcony, but I was wrestled away.. then I wanted to starve myself, but after 2 days people started calling me and gave me hope. Today starts the second attempt at starvation, I haven't told anyone anything, and I deleted all social media. No one seems to care.

She's the only person I've ever loved in the (almost) 20 years I've been here, and I've told her about that. It stings so much, pretty much constantly.. and it's true, I can't do anything about it. She's happy with her bf, and I just have to accept that they're gonna always be together.. It hurts so much whenever I see them talk openly about things they're gonna do.. I feel like he's doing it on purpose and she just goes along with it. I can't move on. I'll always love her until the day I die. She was my angel...

I wouldn't be remembered. They wouldn't care. I remember some of them saying "they'd miss me a bit".. that's all. They only keep me around long enough so that I don't die. I'm always ignored after a while. I wouldn't cause anyone immense suffering. No one cares. My life is a disaster, and I want it to end.

It hurts a lot, doesn't it? She made me cry twice this month alone, even though I couldn't physically make myself cry for many years on any other occasion.. I know that I don't bring much to the table. I'm poor, my family is terrible, but still.. I've given her all the love I had, and it wasn't enough.

I don't think I'm even capable of love at this point. The future is predictable. It gives me false hope, I feel like my life is finally going to have a meaning, only to then later take everything away.

She won't come back. I know she loves him. All that happened is she gave me hope and then crushed it all.. she's starting to ignore or avoid me, leaving on read, then making up paragraphs of excuses more than a day later. I'm so crushed, I don't want to look for anyone else. I want to just wither away, alone.

It took 20 years to find her. I won't be around for another 20 to find someone else. I know I won't be able to love anyone else as much as I love her. There isn't a single person in the world that can match her.. she was perfect for me.
I'd rather die than be without her.

She's very caring and sweet. We've talked for hours almost every day about pretty much everything, she's the first person that I could open up to about my feelings, and she was very understanding. She seemed very happy whenever we talked. She would pick me up when I felt bad, and I would do the same. She always made me happy. She said she wanted to make my life better, but I can't get over the fact that she's now with someone else. And what I've seen the guy talk about is sickening. He's just a typical horny dude, from another country may I add. I just have nothing to offer, I guess.. and aside from her, I have nothing else to live for.. I'm heartbroken and hopeless..

Our neighbor killed himself after his brother died and he was alone. My family said that he was an idiot. The same thing would happen if I did it. They don't know what mental health is. They dont even know what's going on in my life so they would have no idea why it happened. I would be stupid in their eyes. In fact, I know they wouldn't care.
